notes: RobobetToken (src/RobobetToken.sol) is a fixed-supply OpenZeppelin 5.0.2 ERC-20 named Robobet with symbol ROBOBET and 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole supply of 1,000,000,000 ROBOBET (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units) once to msg.sender, the launch factory, which pays it out: the swarm's share to the launch's MerkleDistributor, 88% to the single-sided Uniswap v4 pool paired with IMD, and the remainder to economics.remainderTo. The token has no owner, no mint, no burn or burnFrom, no pause, blacklist, freeze, lock or seize, no transfer tax or burn on transfer, no proxy and no DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT in its runtime, so the supply can never grow and every launch flow moves exactly what it says. There are no application contracts in this launch. pool.initialPrice is provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and the token's supply.
